speaker: Mr Lee Hong Chuang (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
text: I want to thank Senior Parliamentary Secretary Shawn Huang for his reply.

speaker: Mr Lee Hong Chuang (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
text: Has the Government conducted any studies to what extent the CDC vouchers have helped households manage the cost of living?

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: The Government regularly reviews the effectiveness of our schemes to ensure that they continue to help Singaporeans manage cost of living concerns.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: And when necessary, we will complement these structural measures with one-off additional support for households.

speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
text: This approach allows us to provide more responsive and targeted support while remaining fiscally prudent.
